scientific_scope: Prospective source/design gate after P4-v1 open-arena development closure. This gate selects the already-reserved Poissonnier 2026 Experiment 2 Y-maze as a same-study, separate-apparatus predictive-transfer test for the frozen P4-v1 mechanism and parameter triplet. It does not authorize Y-maze biological outcome loading, simulation, scoring, fitting, parameter changes, canonical promotion, or a claim of fully blind external validation.

selected_transfer_source.study: Poissonnier et al. 2026, Pheromone trail following is not modulated by previous visit to food location, distance travelled, or travel direction in the ant Lasius niger

methods_only_public_metadata.source: Published methods section only; no repository Y-maze biological target was opened or materialized for this gate.
methods_only_public_metadata.primary_behavioral_form: binary choice of pheromone-marked arm versus DCM arm
methods_only_public_metadata.published_analysis_family: binomial choice model with direction, experience, pheromone side, and colony structure

blinding_and_contamination_record.contamination_consequence: The reserved Y-maze may be used only as a preregistered same-study cross-apparatus predictive-transfer test. It may not be described as pristine blinded validation or as sufficient by itself for canonical promotion. Any promotion-grade independent validation must use a separately justified source whose outcome surface was not used to fit P4 and whose validation criteria are frozen before outcome access.

prospective_transfer_hypothesis.model_under_test: Frozen P4-v1 hard absolute-detection-gated local Weber steering with candidate-307 parameters unchanged
prospective_transfer_hypothesis.directional_prediction: When one Y-maze arm carries the published trail-pheromone treatment and the other carries DCM, the frozen P4 mechanism should produce above-neutral probability of entering the pheromone-marked arm without direction-, experience-, colony-, side-, or path-specific response parameters.
prospective_transfer_hypothesis.neutral_reference: symmetric 0.5 arm-choice probability under a pheromone-insensitive neutral mechanism, subject to a separately frozen exact simulation/scoring protocol

next_gate.purpose: Freeze exact Y-maze apparatus interpretation, initialization, trail-field mapping, binary-choice endpoint, neutral comparator, simulation budget, RNG/seeds, aggregation, uncertainty, and pass/fail rule before any Y-maze biological outcome file is materialized or parsed.

future_promotion_requirement: A successful same-study Y-maze transfer test would support cross-apparatus predictive transfer but would not alone establish external validity or authorize canonical promotion. A separate promotion-grade independent validation source/design gate remains required.
